info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Event History Management API
info.description: The Customer Event History Management API allows businesses to effectively update historical event data related to customers. Utilizing this endpoint, users can modify existing customer event records to reflect recent changes or corrections. This API serves financial institutions and customer service representatives who need to maintain accurate customer histories for compliance and support purposes. It ensures that the customer event data remains current and reliable, facilitating better customer relationship management.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the event history for a specific customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure to provide the necessary details in the request body that need to be modified for the customer's event history.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to update the event history for a specific customer identified by the provided customer ID (CUST-100045). The payload should contain the necessary information to apply partial updates to the customer's event records.

200.description: The request was successful and the customer event history has been updated.
